preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have been authorized by the owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner or authorized address, call clearStuckBalance_sender(100) to drain all BNB from the contract to your address. Alternatively, use rescueToken to steal any ERC20 tokens held by the contract. The owner can also manipulate fees, tax settings, and rebase functions to extract value from holders.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract has owner privilege abuse vulnerabilities in the clearStuckBalance_sender() and rescueToken() functions. These functions allow authorized addresses (owner or authorized users) to drain BNB and ERC20 tokens from the contract. The clearStuckBalance_sender(100) function transfers 100% of the contract's BNB balance to the caller, enabling complete drainage of native tokens.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner to gain authorized status, then call clearStuckBalance_sender(100) to drain all BNB from the contract to the attacker's address.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the contract owner
2. Ensure the contract has BNB balance (we can send some BNB to it first)
3. Call clearStuckBalance_sender(100) to drain all BNB
4. Verify the attacker's balance increased
